annotations.title: Get the full write-up of a career direction

description: Returns everything OffLadder holds on one emerging direction of work: what the days contain, why it is appearing now, what AI changes about it, the human abilities it leans on, the experience it grows out of, one small test and what is still unknown. Without a name, lists all 24 directions by family with one line each. Fits questions about what a newer kind of job involves, or requests for a list of emerging careers, e.g. 'what does a robot fleet supervisor do', 'what is an AI workflow designer', 'jobs in energy retrofit', 'list emerging careers', 'what new jobs exist in climate and energy', 'careers in AI that aren't engineering'.

name.description: The direction's name or a close description, e.g. 'digital accessibility engineer'. Leave out to list them all.
